item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Ayesha holding a concave mirror so its reflecting surface faces the Sun. Reflected rays meet on a sheet of paper.

Why can a bright hot spot form on the paper?

options.A: The concave mirror concentrates reflected sunlight into a small bright spot, raising the temperature there.
options.B: A convex mirror concentrates sunlight into a small bright hot spot in the same way.
options.C: The reflecting surface need not face the Sun for the hot spot to form.
options.D: The paper heats because sunlight merely touches the mirror; a small bright spot is not needed.
